# Lusid.Sdk.Model.AssetLeg
The underlying instrument representing one side of the TRS and its pay-receive direction.

## Properties

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**Asset** | [**LusidInstrument**](LusidInstrument.md) |  | 
**IncomePolicy** | **string** | Controls what happens to income (coupons, dividends) generated by the Asset.  Defaults to PassThrough, preserving today&#39;s behaviour of emitting income as flows on their natural payment dates.                Supported string (enumeration) values are: [PassThrough, AccrueToReset, Reinvest]. | [optional] 
**InitialPrice** | **decimal?** | The reference price of a single unit of the Asset at inception, used as the starting point (P_0) for  price-return resets. Optional and absent by default, preserving today&#39;s behaviour for TRS definitions  that predate price-return semantics. | [optional] 
**PayReceive** | **string** | Either Pay or Receive stating direction of the asset in the swap.                Supported string (enumeration) values are: [Pay, Receive]. | 
**ResetSchedule** | [**ResetSchedule**](ResetSchedule.md) |  | [optional]
